description: Packs four signals into a stereo pair, alternating two of them on each output sample by sample, for an ES-3 fed over ADAT

params.text: Swaps the order of the two signals packed onto the L output; the lamp is lit while they are swapped, and the setting is stored with the patch
Swaps the order of the two signals packed onto the R output; the lamp is lit while they are swapped, and the setting is stored with the patch

inputs.text: One of the two signals packed onto the L output; the pair take alternate samples and Flip L swaps which of them goes first
One of the two signals packed onto the R output; the pair take alternate samples and Flip R swaps which of them goes first

outputs.text: The left half of the multiplexed pair, alternating between the first two inputs; patch it to one channel of the stereo pair driving the ES-3
The right half of the multiplexed pair, alternating between the last two inputs; patch it to the other channel of that pair

notes: The outputs go to a stereo pair of audio channels driving an ES-3, and the interface has to run at 88.2kHz or 96kHz for the hardware to separate the pairs again.
Each output alternates between two inputs on successive samples, so what comes out of it is not a signal that can be listened to or patched anywhere else in Rack.
